Our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad have made us one of the world's leading premium manufacturer of cars and motorcycles as well as provider of premium financial and mobility services.

At BMW Car IT, a wholly owned subsidiary of BMW AG, we live and breathe software. We design and implement embedded software for electronic control units of the BMW cars as well as related tools and frameworks. By delivering software all the way from the idea to the final product we lead BMW into the future of digitalization and mobility.
We develop innovative graphics software for embedded automotive systems, collaborating closely with UX, hardware, and system architecture teams to deliver premium in-vehicle experiences.

What awaits you?

- You design and develop modern graphics software for embedded systems in current and future BMW vehicle platforms.
- You develop and optimize graphics stacks, including OpenGL ES, Vulkan, and GPU driver integration for embedded automotive systems.
- Furthermore, you implement rendering pipelines, compositing mechanisms, and performance-critical graphics functions.
- You work with hardware suppliers to integrate GPUs and display controllers.
- Moreover, you analyze and improve runtime performance, memory usage, and rendering latency.
- You ceate tools and frameworks for validating graphics functions and contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements to series release.

What should you bring along?

- Strong proficiency in graphic stacks for embedded systems and hands-on experience with graphics APIs such as OpenGL ES, Vulkan, EGL and GPU Drivers.
- Extensive experience in Android graphics architecture (SurfaceFlinger, Hardware Composer) and the Linux graphics stack (wayland, kms, drm).
- Good understanding of GPU architectures, rendering pipelines, real-time system constraints, and experience with debugging/profiling tools like RenderDoc, perf, and Valgrind.
- Several years of professional experience in embedded software development and quality assurance in the automotive industry, focusing on graphics.
- Familiarity with software architectural modeling methods, HMI frameworks (Qt, Kanzi, Unity, Unreal Engine), automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262), and CI/CD pipelines are advantageous.
- Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Would you like to shape the future of automotive graphics software and deliver state-of-the-art visual experiences? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Lead Copywriter; CopywriterStellenbeschreibung:At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.Lead Copywriter, Global Creative Studio (m/f/x)Brand Marketing · Berlin or WarsawAt HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table.ABOUT THE JOBIf you love making words work hard, this might be your job.HelloFresh Group is looking for a Lead Copywriter to join our Creative Studio and help drive copy quality across our demand generation engine. You'll work across the full funnel and across every channel that matters (TV, OOH, paid social, display, CRM, YouTube) with a particular focus on mid-funnel, paid social creative that stops thumbs and starts conversations.This is a hands-on writing role, creating everything from campaign headlines to push notifications, from social hooks to CRM journeys. You'll also bring the strategic thinking to help shape how eight global brands communicate across sixteen markets, and the collaborative instinct to consult with local teams, advise channel owners, and help more junior staffers write better.Crucially, you will help build, train, and socialize AI tools (particularly on Claude and Gemini) to create and maintain  a broad creative toolkit. You will use these tools to generate, iterate, and localize content, but you will be the creative brain behind all LLM work.This position is based in Berlin or Warsaw. Berlin-based employees have required attendance three days per week (Monday to Wednesday) at our Creative Studio in Moabit.WHAT YOU'LL DO- Write sharp, on-brand copy across the full funnel and all major channels (paid social, display, CRM, YouTube, TV, and OOH), with a particular emphasis on mid-funnel paid social creative.- Bring big-picture strategic thinking to campaign briefs and creative concepts, while staying just as comfortable writing a single subject line or a two-second video hook.- Consult with local market copywriting teams across sixteen markets, offering guidance, feedback, and creative direction that keeps their work on-brand and high-quality.- Use AI tools (especially Claude and Gemini) as part of your creative workflow: for ideation, iteration, and developing prompt frameworks and localization pipelines that improve quality and efficiency at scale.- Advise channel owners and marketing stakeholders on copy strategy, messaging hierarchy, and how to make creative work harder at every touchpoint.- Help shape, evolve, and maintain tone of voice and messaging guidelines across eight brands, ensuring they’re clear and practical enough to use at local and global levels.- Partner with designers, videographers, motion designers, and performance marketers to bring creative ideas to life and optimize them for conversion.- Interpret performance data to understand what's working, and use those insights to improve briefs, iterate on copy, and sharpen your craft.- Rigorously proofread copy. Zero typos, zero grammatical errors, no exceptions.- Manage content flows via Google Suite, Airtable, and Jira so copy moves efficiently from brief to stakeholders to market.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR- A full-time copywriter based in, or willing to relocate to, Berlin or Warsaw.- BS/MS from a top-tier university in Communications, Marketing, Creative Writing, or a related field.- 8+ years of copywriting or communications experience, ideally spanning both agency and in-house environments.- A proven track record of high-impact, English-language copy across major digital channels, especially paid social, display, CRM, email, and YouTube.- A strategic thinker who can see the big picture across brands and markets, but who is equally happy polishing a push notification or reworking a subject line.- An experienced AI worker, using LLMs as part of a creative process to generate, refine, and localize copy more effectively.- A natural collaborator who can consult with and advise local teams and channel owners—someone who leads through the quality of their thinking.- Comfortable working within brand and tone guidelines, and experienced enough to know when to push the boundaries.- Ability to write across multiple projects, brands, markets, and tones simultaneously.- A curiosity about audiences and the ability to interpret performance data to refine copy strategy.- Experience with localization and machine translation workflows is a plus.- Agency experience, particularly at a social media-focused or digital agency, is a plus.- Experience working for food or tech brands is a plus.- Knowledge of German, French, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is a plus.ARE YOU UP FOR THE CHALLENGE?To apply, please complete the application and send us a portfolio that shows your range: performance-driven digital copy, campaign thinking across brands or markets, and any examples of how you've worked smarter—whether that's AI-assisted workflows, localization processes, or something else entirely.We're excited to see what you bring to the team.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: WerbeagenturExpertenkenntnisse: KI-Tools, Werbetexten, Konzeption (Werbung, Marketing, PR)

You will work within a team based across Europe to drive food safety and quality compliance with our Produce, Herbs & Fruit (PHF) suppliers, and work collaboratively with our procurement, sourcing, supply chain and distribution centre teams. The role will share best practice, create standardized ways of working, drive improvement in food safety & quality and lead on various strategic projects to ensure we delight our customers.What You Will Be Doing:You will...- Perform on-site supplier visits and audits to manage their approval and drive strategic improvements in quality to decrease complaints and increase customer satisfaction- Use your expertise and knowledge from industry and the supply base to develop best practice ways of working with your suppliers and internally- Strategically manage supplier product quality and performance. Delivering focussed error (complaint) reduction initiatives and identifying projects that will improve our quality and safety standards- Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance- Investigate and manage quality issues with suppliers to ensure customer availability and quality is not compromised with thorough root cause analysis and corrective action- Own your category area to achieve key performance indicators relating to out of specification deliveries, customer complaints, and compliance metrics- Manage and coordinate the onboarding of new suppliers and products ensuring compliance to food safety, legal and quality standardsWho You Are:- 4+ years of experience in quality and food safety management, ideally within the produce industry- Experience in auditing food manufacturers; additional food safety qualifications (e.g. HACCP, internal auditing) are highly desirable- Willingness to travel, including some international trips; 50% of time spent at suppliers, distribution centres and the base office- Excellent English communication and negotiation skills; pragmatic in solving time-sensitive issues - German skills are a big plus- Confident decision-maker who remains calm under pressure and in challenging situations- Thrives in a fast-paced environment with the ability to multitask across competing priorities- Comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams across HelloFresh markets (UK, DACH, France, Nordics, BNL)- intermediate to advanced skills in Google Suite / MS OfficeWhat you will get in return:● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes● Company pension scheme● Gym membership● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme● Dog friendly office!● Nursery support scheme● Cycle to work scheme● Group Life AssuranceLocation: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, LondonTo be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.Hybrid Working PolicyWe offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Lebensmittelsicherheitssystem HACCP, Microsoft Office, Lieferantenmanagement, Lebensmittelkontrolle, -überwachung, Lebensmitteluntersuchung

jobs.description: Join us in shaping the aviation of tomorrow! As part of a globally operating group, we are among the world's leading companies in the development and production of innovative cargo solutions for the aviation industry. With passion, the highest standards of quality, and the courage to innovate, we create solutions that move the world and make us a strong partner to the most renowned aircraft manufacturers. Become part of our team in Miesbach and shape with us the future of aviation!   Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You take overall technical responsibility for all projects within the Business Unit Boeing. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams in alignment with the Vice President Engineering and the Business Unit Manager. You own the system architecture and define the technical solution strategy. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams. You ensure compliance with all requirements regarding quality, cost, schedule, and risk. You are accountable for requirements management, system design, integration, and verification & validation. You prepare and lead technical reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR). You collaborate closely with project management, customers, partners, and certification authorities. You drive the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and standards. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS As the ideal candidate, you hold a master's degree in electrical engineering or a comparable qualification. You have more than 5 years of professional experience within aerospace development and technical leadership. You have basic understanding of EASA Certification Rules (CS25) and Part21J regulations. You demonstrate strong analytical and conceptual skills. You show a high level of decision-making ability and excellent communication skills. You have experience in international projects; this is considered an advantage. You communicate confidently in English, and you benefit from additional German language skills. OUR BENEFITS Flexibility and Hybrid Working. We know that flexibility in the workplace is crucial. That's why we offer flexible working hours and hybrid working models, depending on the area of work. This allows you to balance your professional and personal life optimally. Personal Development. Stagnation? Not with us! We support your professional development through targeted training, further education opportunities, and educational leave. Your potential is our drive! Compensation and Benefits. In addition to performance-based compensation, we offer an attractive company-funded pension plan. You will also benefit from employee discounts and subsidies, such as for work clothing, safety shoes, and daily meals. Wellbeing.Your health and well-being are important to us! With offers like bike leasing through JobRad and access to Wellpass, we support you in staying active and healthy. Additionally, our employee assistance program meinEAP is available to provide professional help with health, professional, and personal challenges. Submit your application now with all required documents!

Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory.Discover Impactful WorkAs a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows.You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.A Day in the Life:Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements.What to expect:- Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution.- Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows.- Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.- Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence.- Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization.- Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions.- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes.- Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership.Keys to Success:Education- BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience.Experience- 5+ years of hands-on bioprocessing experience, ideally within Process Development, with strong expertise in downstream processing.- Demonstrated experience with downstream purification technologies, including chromatography, UF/DF, centrifugation, and related unit operations.- Proven track record of technical engagement, process troubleshooting, and problem solving within Process Development and/or biomanufacturing environments.- Experience supporting process scale-up, technology transfer, and process optimization from development through pilot and manufacturing scale.- Hands-on experience with commonly used chromatography systems/skids at laboratory, pilot, and manufacturing scale, including the ability to operate systems and interpret data using commonly used chromatography software.- Practical experience with column packing at small, pilot, and/or manufacturing scale.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Deep understanding of bioprocessing and downstream purification workflows, with the ability to approaches to identify opportunities for improvement.- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT), Design of Experiments (DoE), and Quality by Design (QbD) principles, including relevant ICH communicate analytical data.- Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel and JMP; experience with scripting or additional analytical tools is an advantage.- Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientists, engineers, operators, and senior technical stakeholders.- Strong problem-solving and influencing skills, with demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional and matrixed environments.- Experience using Salesforce.com (SFDC CRM) for customer engagement, opportunity, and activity tracking.- Fluent in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.- Based in Germany or Austria, ideally in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, with convenient access to a major airport or transportation hub to support frequent travel across the assigned territory.- Willing and able to travel up to 50%, primarily across Germany and, depending on home location, Austria.- employee benefits. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Government Affairs Manager at Siemens Energy, you will help shape the political, regulatory, and geopolitical environment in which we operate. You will translate policy developments into business opportunities, build trusted relationships with government stakeholders, and support Siemens Energy’s leadership in advancing the global energy transition.Working closely with Business Areas, regional leadership (Hubs), and Executive Board Members, you will identify emerging political trends, assess risks and opportunities, and develop advocacy strategies that support the company’s growth agenda. You will be the interlink to and representative for selected HUBs and the corporate Government Affairs department. Your work will directly contribute to creating favorable market conditions for energy infrastructure, decarbonization technologies, grid modernization, and energy security solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact * Monitoring and analysis of political, regulatory, and geopolitical developments* Advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management across key public and industry stakeholders* Political positioning and policy support aligned with Siemens Energy’s strategic priorities* Identification of policy-driven business opportunities, including incentives, industrial policy, and funding programs* Preparation of executive briefings, talking points, stakeholder dossiers, and strategic assessments* Cross-functional coordination and external representation to strengthen Siemens Energy’s positioning in the global energy transitionWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Economics, Law, or a related field* Several years of professional experience in Government Affairs, Public Affairs, Public Policy, Regulatory Affairs, diplomacy, consulting, or related fields* Strong understanding of European and international energy policy, industrial policy, and geopolitical developments* Proven stakeholder management, analytical, strategic, and communication skills, including executive-level presentations and briefing materials* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced international environment, manage multiple priorities, and demonstrate high integrity and commitment to compliance* Fluent English and good German; additional languages advantageousAbout the TeamThe Government Affairs department supports Siemens Energy's mission to become the world's most valued energy technology company. We connect business priorities with public policy, identify geopolitical risks and opportunities, and work with governments and institutions to promote energy security, industrial competitiveness, and decarbonization. Our team combines policy expertise, stakeholder engagement, geopolitical analysis, and strategic advocacy to create business value and enable long-term growth across global markets.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
